title: Simplemind
summary: Simplemind is a red-aura mental spell. It is a power of suggestion that manipulates or erases someone's memory. After casting, the Seeker generally dictates the person what they shall forget or believe. Simplemind is primarily effective against weak minds, thus is not very effective against trained Seekers.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
In Venice, DeFoe used Simplemind on a freaked out gondolier who had seen Titans, ordering him to forget everything he had witnessed. [A Seeker Is Born]

In Rouen, Zhalia Moon used Simplemind against a police officer to make Peter escape. [Into the River of Secrets]

In the Paris Catacombs, Zhalia used the spell against Mr. MacTavish, who had guessed her identity because of her powers. [Divide and Conquer]

In the Valley of the Kings, Zhalia used Simplemind to knock Unnamed Suit 036 unconscious and steal his map of the Tomb of Nefertiti. [The Sceptre Deception].

In Paris, Zhalia used the spell to wipe out a whole family' memory, after they witnessed Titans breaking out of the Cathedral of Notre Dame and asked for explanations. Lok then remarked that Simplemind would be useful to make the Blood Spiral forget about their nefarious goals, but Zhalia disproved him by explaining that the spell isn't very effective on Seekers. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

In Lambert house, Dante Vale used the spell on Kathy Lambert after she saw the Huntik team using their powers. [Back Home]

full_text:
Simplemind is a red-aura mental spell. It is a power of suggestion that manipulates or erases someone's memory. After casting, the Seeker generally dictates the person what they shall forget or believe. Simplemind is primarily effective against weak minds, thus is not very effective against trained Seekers.

History

In Venice, DeFoe used Simplemind on a freaked out gondolier who had seen Titans, ordering him to forget everything he had witnessed. [A Seeker Is Born]

In Rouen, Zhalia Moon used Simplemind against a police officer to make Peter escape. [Into the River of Secrets]

In the Paris Catacombs, Zhalia used the spell against Mr. MacTavish, who had guessed her identity because of her powers. [Divide and Conquer]

In the Valley of the Kings, Zhalia used Simplemind to knock Unnamed Suit 036 unconscious and steal his map of the Tomb of Nefertiti. [The Sceptre Deception].

In Paris, Zhalia used the spell to wipe out a whole family' memory, after they witnessed Titans breaking out of the Cathedral of Notre Dame and asked for explanations. Lok then remarked that Simplemind would be useful to make the Blood Spiral forget about their nefarious goals, but Zhalia disproved him by explaining that the spell isn't very effective on Seekers. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

In Lambert house, Dante Vale used the spell on Kathy Lambert after she saw the Huntik team using their powers. [Back Home]
